name: Baros Alexston
summary: In Stormwind City Hall, Baros Alexston tends the capital he helped rebuild. He was once close to Edwin VanCleef in the Stonemasons Guild, but stayed loyal to the crown when the guild split.

sections.title: From the Farmstead to the Scaffold
sections.body:
Baros grew up at the Alexston Farmstead in Westfall's rolling grasslands. Thieves overran and burned his family's home while he was young. Before they fled, his father hid their cherished heirlooms across the grounds.

Baros later went to the capital and joined the Stonemasons Guild. For years, he worked beside Guildmaster Edwin VanCleef as they raised Stormwind anew from the ashes of the First War.

sections.title: A Bitter Parting of Ways
sections.body:
When Stormwind's rebuilding ended, the House of Nobles refused the promised payment. Furious protests followed, the Stonemasons Guild dissolved, and deadly riots filled the streets. Edwin VanCleef led the unpaid artisans into exile, where they formed the Defias Brotherhood.

The nobles offered Baros the post of City Architect if he disavowed the uprising. He opposed the guild's turn to violent banditry and accepted. The choice left a bitter rift between him and his former comrades.

sections.title: The Ghost in the Dead Mines
sections.body:
Baros oversees the capital's upkeep from his desk in City Hall. Mathias Shaw of SI:7 discreetly owes him a favor.

After VanCleef fell in the depths of the Deadmines, an unsent letter addressed to Baros remained on the Defias leader's corpse. The letter recalls a bond broken by politics, treason, and bloodshed over Stormwind's foundations.

faq.q: Where can I find Baros Alexston?
faq.answer: You can find Baros Alexston inside Stormwind City Hall, on the north side of Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.

faq.q: What is Baros Alexston's role in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Baros oversees Stormwind City's construction, upkeep, and architectural planning as its Chief Architect.

faq.q: How does Baros know Edwin VanCleef?
faq.answer: Baros and Edwin VanCleef were close colleagues in the Stonemasons Guild. They worked side by side to rebuild Stormwind after the First War. When the House of Nobles refused to pay the workers, VanCleef led a rebellion while Baros stayed and became City Architect.

faq.q: Why didn't Baros join the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Baros opposed the guild's turn to violent revolt. The nobles offered him the City Architect post if he refused to follow VanCleef, and Baros accepted.

faq.q: What is the unsent letter found on Edwin VanCleef?
faq.answer: After Edwin VanCleef died in the Deadmines, an unsent letter addressed to Baros Alexston was found on his body. It speaks to lingering resentment and unresolved history between the former craftsmen.

faq.q: What is Baros Alexston's connection to Westfall?
faq.answer: Baros grew up at the Alexston Farmstead in Westfall. After thieves burned it, his family fled. He recruits adventurers to reclaim his childhood possessions, including his first compass.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can see the painful compromise that split the Stonemasons Guild. Its craftsmen had poured their lives into rebuilding the capital.
As a rogue in Stormwind, you have a connection through Baros to Master Mathias Shaw and SI:7. They quietly owe the architect a favor despite his past ties to VanCleef.
As a human from Westfall, you may know the surname Baros from the ruined Alexston Farmstead. Thieves and gnolls now overrun it.
